notes: Exact ADAM Audio A4V official product page: two-way active studio monitor with one 4-inch Multi-Layer Mineral woofer and one X-ART tweeter (two transducers). The page specifies 52 Hz–45 kHz frequency response at -6 dB and 130 W total peak internal amplifier power; the latter is stored only as amplifier_output, not passive-speaker power handling or RMS output. Maximum SPL of 100 dB per speaker at 1 m is not sensitivity. Sensitivity, driver impedance, free-air resonant frequency and voice-coil size are not published here. The response bounds retain their stated -6 dB context; no response points or directivity dataset is imported. Source: https://www.adam-audio.com/en/a-series/a4v/.

Exact ADAM Audio S3H official product page: three-way active midfield monitor (optimally horizontal) with two 7-inch ELE woofers, one 4-inch DCH midrange driver and one S-ART tweeter (four transducers). Sensitivity, driver impedance, free-air resonant frequency and voice-coil size are not published here.
